name: Kaia
self_text: I am an Italian in my 40s with a background in nursing. Outside of my studies, I love swing dancing for the energy and movement. I am currently studying language practice. I work best with working through problems together. I can meet in person, and I am free Saturday afternoon or Sunday afternoon.

requests.request_text: I need us to overlap on in person. It would be nice if you are into working through problems together or a step-by-step walkthrough session, and a small bonus if you are into language practice.
